description: This 3D bar chart illustrates the accuracy of language models—Davinci-003, ChatGPT, and BARD—across two tasks: Classification and Generation. The horizontal axis displays the task categories, labeled “Classification” and “Generation”, and arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” and ranges from 0.0 to 0.8 with tick marks at 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. For each task, there is a set of three bars representing the aforementioned language models. The bars are arranged from left to right in the order of Davinci-003, ChatGPT, and BARD. Each bar exhibits a color gradient, transitioning from blue at the base to green and then yellow at the top. For the “Classification” task, the height of the bars are approximately 0.15 for Davinci-003, 0.42 for ChatGPT, and 0.52 for BARD. For the “Generation” task, bar heights are approximately 0.48 for Davinci-003, 0.61 for ChatGPT, and 0.73 for BARD. No bars are explicitly emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations, and the bars are arranged by task, with the models shown side-by-side within each task.
